_comment: Copy this file to setup.json and fill in your values. setup.json is gitignored; this file is tracked.

git._comment: All fields are optional. Omit the section entirely if you don't need Git identity in the container.
git.name: Your Name
git._gpg_key_comment: Passphrase-less signing key expected (the entrypoint runs gpg --batch --import non-interactively). Generate one with: gpg --batch --passphrase '' --quick-generate-key "Your Name <you@example.com>" ed25519 sign 0 — then export it with: gpg --export-secret-keys --armor <KEYID> > ./entrypoint/id_signing.asc  (drop the .asc into the entrypoint/ dir; gpg_key is resolved against it the same way as claude.global_md). signing_key_id is the long key ID / fingerprint from: gpg --list-secret-keys --keyid-format=long
git._ssh_keys_comment: Generate a key pair with: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com" -f ./entrypoint/id_ed25519_github  (then drop the private key file into the entrypoint/ dir referenced by ssh_file below; .gitignore already excludes id_ed25519*/id_rsa*/id_ecdsa* there).

ssh_keys._comment: ssh_file is resolved against the mounted files directory, same as claude.global_md. host is written as a Host block in ~/.ssh/config.

scripts._comment: Optional. dir is resolved against the mounted files directory, same as claude.global_md. Every *.sh file directly inside it runs at container start, in sorted filename order — prefix names with 00-, 01-, etc. to control ordering. Executable files run directly; non-executable files run via bash.

claude._comment: All arrays are optional. Empty arrays or absent keys are silently skipped.
claude._skills_dir_comment: Optional. Resolved against the mounted files directory, same as global_md. Every immediate subdirectory inside it is installed as a skill at ~/.claude/skills/<name> (e.g. claude-skills/3gpp-expert/SKILL.md -> ~/.claude/skills/3gpp-expert/SKILL.md).

http_mcps._comment: HTTP MCP: name and url are required.
http_mcps.name: notion

stdio_mcps._comment: Stdio MCP: command is the full shell command string, split at runtime.
stdio_mcps.name: m365

plugins._comment: marketplace_id is the Marketplace path; plugin_id is the install name.

copilot._comment: Same structure as claude. Copilot plugin install uses plugin_id@marketplace_id compound form.
copilot._skills_dir_comment: Optional. Resolved against the mounted files directory, same as claude.global_md. Every immediate subdirectory inside it is installed as a skill at ~/.copilot/skills/<name>.
